label: neiso 26 ps diag
definition: neiso 26 ps-diag (DIAGNOSIS, not a calibration keeper). Byte-faithful re-solve of the neiso-25 fullstop keeper config (--commitment --ct-deployment --hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly; identical offer curves/overlays/outages, scarcity off, PS adder 0) to surface and root-cause the newly-wired C5b storage-throughput metric. FINDING: NEISO PS under-cycles (2025 model 0.59 vs EIA-930 2.08 TWh, -72%) NOT because of a storage defect but because the energy-only LP collapses the scarcity tail (model >$200 hrs 0/0/14 vs actual 72/43/290; 2025 max $258.98 vs ~$1110). PS round-trip breakeven needs an intraday price ratio >1.25 (RTE 0.80); the model's median daily ratio is 1.15, so PS clears only ~50 days/yr (~20 cycles vs the ~107 needed for 2 TWh) -- energy cap (18.6 GWh) and the $0 adder are non-binding. Step-1 measurement audit: 2023 EIA-930 PS is fully blank and 2024 begins only in Nov (14.8% coverage), so the old +47% '2024 over-cycle' was a 2-month partial scored as a full year; fixed by a coverage gate in eia_loader (storage series <50% reported -> SKIPPED). 2025 under-cycle is a real MODEL MISS handed to the scarcity/winter-gas workstream (daily AGT spot U4 / NEISO reserve scarcity pricing) -- NO storage knob added (claude.md #1/#11/#12). DETERMINATION NOT-YET (C5b storage 2025 + pre-existing C1 CC_REGULAR 2025 +2.15 TWh inherited from neiso-25). See docs/multi-iso/neiso-ps-undercycling-diagnosis-2026-06.md.
